notes.title: TPP工作室新作，开放世界江湖模拟器《龙胤立志传》首次测试现已开启
notes.content:
嘿，各位老朋友们！好久不见啦~
感谢大家一直以来的支持，是你们让《归家异途》的世界变得完整，也让我们有动力继续做更多好玩的游戏！

憋了这么久，终于可以大声宣布：​我们的新作《龙胤立志传》首次测试正式开启啦！​
现在前往Steam商店页面，点击"申请测试权限"按钮即可免费入库体验。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3202030

我们怀着对武侠的一腔热忱，希望能够做出一款自由的开放世界江湖模拟器。这里的一草一木、一招一式都倾注了我们对武侠的热爱。如今剑胚初成，虽未至吹毛断发之境，却已蕴三分侠气。
虽然还不够完美，但正因如此才需要测试来听取各位大侠的真知灼见。期待与你在这片江湖相遇，共同见证它的成长。

--------------------
《龙胤立志传》是一款融合门派经营的开放世界武侠游戏。在各大门派割据一方的神州之上，你可以自由驰骋，历经奇遇，修炼神功，踏上行侠仗义或行凶作恶之路。也可以经营自己的门派，从无名小派成长为武林霸主，攻城略地，称霸一方，最终谱写一段独一无二的武林传奇。

点击查看PV
--------------------
游戏亮点
探索真实江湖
从繁华市井到塞外荒原，你可以自由探索神州每一寸土地。游历动态的武侠世界，体验即时发生的无数事件，结识各方能人异士，体悟江湖快意恩仇。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/d60471671d7f875fab62271f3797ebb238dd32e5.gif

江湖儿女之间从来不会缺少爱恨情仇。世界中近千名NPC皆拥有独特的性格、倾向和喜好。你可以投其所好成为莫逆之交，或是暗箭伤人结下深仇大恨。若交情匪浅，他们还会飞鸽传书与你邀约相聚，请求救援，或相约共闯龙潭虎穴，一同夺取惊人宝藏！你也可以选择心仪之对象，海誓山盟，喜结连理。但若三心二意，始乱终弃，恐怕也难逃严峻之惩罚。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/fce7cf6dc75118309d8a87ceeaa129ebcef22112.gif

修炼绝世神功
从武当少林的名门正宗，到唐门五毒的剑走偏锋，乃至墨家神机门的机关异兽，近千种武学自由搭配，打通经脉功法，将你的角色培养成独树一帜的武林高手。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/355778d3aabfca72dc52d70a2f658948afa68dbc.gif

打造最强门派
从外门弟子一步步积累门派功绩，直至成为掌门！管理门派建筑营造，科研外交；将天下神功尽数收入藏经阁，供弟子修习参阅；设置每名弟子的工作重心，因材施教，并率领他们惩奸除恶或横行霸道；最终将自己的门派建设成江湖中一支举足轻重之力量。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/39554617242e65fb7d5b64668c2f371b3bfe1d23.gif

书写乱世传奇
乱世是专属于侠客的舞台，你可以招贤纳士，合纵连横，率领弟子与其他门派一较高下，攻占并且吞并敌方的城池。或许终有一日能够一统神州，成就万世之功业！

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/ccb0ac148477f8d55e86f920b431f2ae8db8886e.gif

--------------------
游玩反馈问卷
《龙胤立志传》还在成长阶段，每一个真实的反馈对我们都非常珍贵。
无论你是喜欢现在的玩法，还是遇到了任何不爽的体验，都请告诉我们——你的每一条建议，都可能让这个江湖世界变得更好。

我们将在5月6日，在完成问卷的侠士中，随机抽取3位，赠送steam礼品卡。

 问卷直达
游戏体验反馈：https://x9w7qu366w.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcnTyEdS9NEkCyQNInqH5eFnb
Bug问题反馈：https://x9w7qu366w.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcnxH2ZwOEF3y1azYMKQX3uSb

--------------------

notes.title: Home Behind2 Early Access Available Now
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/6b83c72c527d57399cfe84851a41c6f05d852ead.jpg

Home Behind2 developed by TPP Studio has been launched on Steam by Early Access on January 22, 2021!ːsteamhappyː

INTRODUCTION
Home Behind 2 is a Roguelike RPG which takes place in Scaria, a country engulfed in a civil war for 10 years. Lead a patchwork group of revolutionary fighters into the depths of the government's territory as you struggle to overthrow a brutal authoritarian regime!

STORY
Home Behind2 will take players back to the Scaria, which is under the brutal rule of dictatorship. Some people resisted, some succumbed, some fell...
However, even if the road ahead is dark, there are still sporadic fire of hope in the war. 
The female college student Banan, the abandoned agent Prince and the chief's son Haroun will form a temporary guerrilla team and continue to advance in the dark.

FEATURE

 Explore the randomly generated areas of western Scaria in this Roguelike RPG as you adventure, occupy enemy oil fields, and claim cities in the name of the Revolutionaries.
 A variety of unique terrains host hundreds of random events and buildings. Play to your team's strengths as you decide how to solve problems presented by your environment.
 Recruit and train dozens of guerilla fighters. Unlock 36 jobs, each with their own talents, stats, and battle skills, and assign your fighters to your team as you see fit.
 A strategic real-time combat system. Pause time to command your teammates at any time, or use tactics to deal devastating blows to your enemies.
 Random drops of weapons and armor. Hundreds of weapons spanning from World War II until the modern age await your discovery.
 Machine guns, flamethrowers, or rocket launchers - which will you mount on your vehicles as your travel deeper into Scaria and confront evermore dangerous mechanized enemies?
 Build and upgrade a camp for your Revolutionaries, allowing you to assign tactics, cook food, upgrade your technologies, and craft armor for your fighters.
 Learn about Scaria's epic history of war and revolution through a massive main campaign and a multitude of side missions.


And their destiny is competely under your decision.

notes.title: Thank you for your support! Home Behind2 is coming soon!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38450896/515678d0c5de152a72ac1aef448901622c096636.png
Greeting from the Producer
Thank you for your support! Home Behind2 is coming soon!

I am ZPP from TPP Studio, the producer of Home Behind2.
First of all, thank you all for your attention and support to the Home Behind series. 
Your love for our game has always been the biggest motivation for our development.

The first generation of Home Behind was released in 2016 and was also the first work of TPP Studio.
 I am honored to receive a lot of support and encouragement from you since then. 
But at that time, the development capability of us were limited. 
In fact, there are still many shortcomings and room for improvement in our works.

Although Home Behind2 is still being developed by the two of us, we have accumulated more experience and abilities, and have considered the suggestions and voices from many players. 
Therefore, this game will be closer to our dream work compared to the first generation.

Now, let me briefly introduce the upcoming Home Behind2.

The Story of Home Behind2
In Home Behind 2, we travel 10 years in the past to Scaria, homeland of the protagonist from our previous story. Ruled by Akadullah, a brutal dictator, citizens of Scaria are beginning to call for liberation and revolution.

This game is no longer a journey of finding daughter alone, but an adventure story of leading a whole team to seek victory. Banan, a female college student studying abroad, has decided to return to her homeland to participate in the revolution. With help from Prince, an eclectic agent from the Norto Republic, and Haroun, the disgraced son of a tribal leader, will you be able to face the dangers of western Scaria?

About Demo and complete version
In order to let players experience part of the essence of the game earlier, we have released a Demo of Home Behind2 a month ago. 
We are more than happy to hear from players about their  enthusiasm and love for the demo. And we have also receive many eager voices for the complete version.

Here I can tell you that the current progress of the game development is in a state where the main chapters are complete and fully playable. 
Many contents that are not opened and displayed in the demo version, as well as the complete plot of hundreds of thousands of words...These will all be reflected in the complete version.

Early Access is coming!
In order to further develop new content and improve the game, as well as let everyone play the complete content of Home Behind2 as soon as possible, we decided to release it by Early Access model on Steam in the near future.

We also believe that with the early access model, you can interact more actively with other players, collect opinions and suggestions from everyone, respond to everyone's expectations, and make the game better.

Winter Sale and Release Date
During this winter sale, in order to thank you for your support, the previous work will have a historically low discount (70% off). In addition, we will officially announce the release time and other information of Home Behind2 that everyone cares about most during the winter sale period (which means a few days later).

Best Wishes for all of you
By following the official Facebook & Twitter account of Coconut Island Games, you could receive the latest information about us.

Finally, wish all of you Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! Thank you very much for your support of Home Behind series. 

Best Regards,

ZPP

notes.title: Style and Substance Meet in Gordian Quest Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Dive into the new turn-based roguelike deck builder with a stunning comic art style

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018259/b608024f6b89aae908bf6ab177f7bf6b5d667d57.jpg

We are happy to tell you that Gordian Quest, a fantasy roguelike deck builder Gordian Quest is now available on Steam Early Access. Combining elements of turn-based combat, strategy and deck building, Gordian Quest will have players set out on a perilous journey with their party of heroes to expel ancient curses that are rampaging the land!

And there is a special 10%off discount in the first week, don't miss it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/981430/_/

A sinister curse corrupts the land. Darkness reigns. Monsters roam. Scoundrels loot. Cowards flee. Heroes emerge. 

Lead heroes on an adventure to save what’s left of this fallen world and destroy the root of evil abound. Will you fall at the claws of your enemies or the consequences of your poor decisions? Your Gordian Quest is about to begin.

Gordian Quest is an epic roguelike / lite adventure that combines the best elements of deckbuilding, tactical combat and strategic decision-making. You will form parties of heroes whom you will have to lead and manage on grueling missions. Help them forge bonds and discover new skills among them. Be fearless and unwavering as you work to unravel the curses laid upon the lands and defeat the ultimate evil at the heart of it all.

http://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/981430/manuals/bear.jpg?t=1571625955


***A list of Early Access features include***


One Act - The Early Access version features one Act, providing 5-6 hours of playtime per playthrough.
Six heroes - At the moment, players can choose from six different heroes each with their own unique class, skills, and playstyle to form a party of three and bring to adventure. At launch, there is a swordhand, a cleric, a ranger, a scoundrel, a druid and a spellbinder. 
Hundreds of skills - The heroes have a combined total of close to 500 passive and active skills that can be deployed during turn-based battles, allowing players to discover and  formulate their favorite combos. 
Train and equip heroes - Heroes can be upgraded, trained and equipped with a large selection of weapons, armor and enchanted trinkets to enhance their abilities.
High replayability - Procedurally generated maps and dungeons and randomized hero skills make each playthrough different from the last.
Various difficulty levels - Take on hardcore mode for a teeth-gritting permadeath experience, or play more casually where death is only a setback.
Loot galore - Gather items and relics throughout your journey to boost your heroes’ abilities. In the future, you will also encounter mysterious items that can bless your heroes but also cripple them with a curse at the same time.
Carryover rewards and progression system - Get rewarded the more you play. Progressing in Acts with each hero lets them start off with a bit more resources, items, or even granting the ability to modify their starting decks.



***Additional features and content planned for the full version***

Three more Acts - The completed game will feature four fully fleshed out Acts to explore - each with new heroes, skills, quests, relics, items and NPCs to discover. Each Act will introduce new gameplay mechanics that expand on and enrich the base game experience.
More heroes - Encounter more heroes from all over the realm and form new party combos and relationships. We are anticipating adding at least 10-16 more heroes.
Relationship system - Future development will introduce a unique system where bonds of friendship, rivalry, mentorship or even love among the heroes in the party can be uncovered to unlock secret combo abilities. 
Shape the course of your adventure - Align yourself with different factions, embark on side quests and eventually shape the course of your adventure with critical decisions.
Endless mode - This special mode makes the game a perpetual adventure and allows you to keep on questing, slaying more monsters and collecting more heroes, skills, relics and weapons.
PVP mode - Engage in skirmish fights with other players using your preferred mix of heroes and skills.

notes.title: New Update: Children in the War
notes.content:
制作人ZPP语

“战乱连连的地区，受到最深伤害的往往都是最为无辜的儿童，但人们对于他们的悲惨遭遇并不是非常了解。我们在研究了动荡地区的儿童状况后，决定在新版本中添加“娃娃兵”这个元素。乍一看可能会觉得非常不人道，但我们的确是怀着悲悯的心情选择了这个元素的，因为我们觉得，没有什么能够比用仇恨跟冷血挤占掉儿童本来该有的天真无邪更让人心痛的事情了。

虽然无力改变现状，但我们依然在游戏中尽量呈现出了我们希望发生的现实。很难说这次的更新内容会让你们喜欢，但希望能够借此让战乱地区的儿童获得更多的关注。”

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238209/349a67bbff3661174eda8663748e7675a988a8bb.jpg

时隔多日，归家异途总算迎来了本次的更新内容，讲述在战争中儿童的故事，在玩家归家的旅途中，不仅仅是主角失散了女儿，在战争中，许多的儿童都在经历着悲惨的生活，面对他们，你会怎么做呢！

本次更新的主要内容
1.新增一段完整的分支剧情，你将在旅程中面临全新的威胁，以往的技巧是否还能有用呢？
2.增加一种新敌人，也许是敌人吧：儿童兵以及新地点：训练营
3.添加剧情相关的信件和笔记，以展现更多细节

希望你们继续喜欢本游戏。

notes.title: New Update: Children in the War
notes.content:
A Letter from the developer, ZPP
“Innocent children are the biggest victims of wars, but people barely understand their painful experience. We decided to add new contents for those “Child soldiers”, after we researched their miserable conditions in war zones. 

Some players may think it’s cruel, but we did make these contents with grief and sympathy from the bottom of our heart. There’s nothing more inhuman than depriving children’s innocent and pure. 

Although we don’t have the power to change their situation, we still want to express our expectations in the game. It’s hard to say: please enjoy it. But we do hope that more and more people will pay attention to those kids in war zones.”

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238209/349a67bbff3661174eda8663748e7675a988a8bb.jpg

It takes months, and we finally complete the new content of Home Behind! It tells a story about the children in the war zones. During the war, our main character is not the only one who lost everything. Hundreds of kids are suffering, and what would you do if you were there?

Contents of new update:
1. A new storyline. You’ll face new threats. 
2. New type of ‘enemy’(maybe) : Child Soldiers. And a new map: Training Battalion.
3. Letters and notes related to the story. Showing more details of facts.

Hope you’ll continue loving our game.

notes.title: v1.134 New Features
notes.content:
New random event: Rebel Flag. Chance of appearing increases when rebels catch up to you.
Added new weapon disassembling feature. Press and hold right click on a weapon to disassemble into parts for crafting. Disassembling rate is affected by Workshop level.
Added new toys which can increase Max Mood limit, be disassembled into parts, or given to Refugee Children.
Added new NPCs: Refugee Child and Traveling Merchant.
Added a new Hardcore Mode which unlocks after beating the game once. Only auto save upon exiting the game is available. Save will be erased upon death.
Added new achievement: Hardcore Mode is Highly Difficult.
Increased visual effects of fog at night.
Added new crafting recipes for food and special parts.Adjusted game balance and difficulty.Fixed a few bugs.

notes.title: V1.13 New Features
notes.content:
- Added support for English, Japanese, Portuguese and Chinese (Traditional). Switch between these languages in the in-game settings menu.
- Added new auto fight feature
- Added Steam Trading Cards
- Length of full journey has been reduced
- Adjustments to character EXP gain and rebel pursuing speed
- Lowered number of items required for crafting
- Increased number of some items dropped at the beginning of the game
- Increased effect of Fitness on character's defense
- Increased accuracy for strength weapons
- Increased strength gained from meat cut from dead animals
- Adjusted difficulty of various enemies
- Adjusted new player tutorial and some UI elements
- Adjusted map UI

- Fixed various game play bugs
- Fixed a bug related to sound playback


Overview:
- Normal update: Game balancing and increase effects of Strength and Fitness
- Rare update: Added auto fight (enable in settings)
- Epic update: See how you match up against players from all over the world with support for new languages!
- Legendary update: Try the new Steam Trading Cards feature!
- Things you won't notice: Fixed various bugs

notes.title: V1.121更新日志
notes.content:
- 增加了大地图功能，玩家现在可以随时看到整体旅程的进度
- 增加了明信片以及纸片的收集图鉴
- 增加了纸片文本的配图照片
- 增加了集齐纸片图鉴的新成就
- 增加了通关职业在职业选择界面的特殊标志
- 增加了药箱自动补充的功能，无需手动点选

- 调整优化了部分音效
- 调整了不会腐烂的食品以及部分普通食品的回复效果以及交易估价
- 调整对话时间，改为暂停时间流逝
- 调整主角点击判定，避免角色遮挡身后的物品
- 调整了中后期生存、战斗以及BOSS战难度
- 调整增强了力量和体质在战斗中的作用

- 修复了被炸死的人战斗标记不消失的BUG
- 修复了臭水潭捞出不科学食物的BUG
- 修复了背包界面按下ESC键的BUG

说人话：
- 普通级更新：游戏的画面元素比以前丰满了一丢丢
- 稀有级更新：平衡性在动大刀子以前先磨一会会
- 史诗级更新：从现在开始你可以选中被主角和板车遮住的东西了！
- 传奇级更新：从现在开始你可以在游戏中肆意屠戮开发组和发行组工作人员了！新版音效中，所有男路人打招呼语音为游戏开发ZPP同学倾情献声，女路人打招呼语音为Esther被抓壮丁懵逼献声……
- 没有人在意级更新：修复了一些BUG

大版本更新预告：
游戏的全套卡牌系统正在制作中，很带感的那种，如果你是本游戏写实风的忠实粉丝……可能会懵逼嘿嘿哈哈哈哈哈
游戏流程长短、战斗系统体验、合成系统平衡（包括测验分解武器是否破坏平衡）、属性平衡、后期游戏体验……均在加急开发中，争取早日呈现给大家
English version has finished the first world part up to now. A native English speaker is doing the translation. We are trying our best to prepare to release mul-language version(including English, Janpanese and maybe more) in the next build. Tons of thanks for waiting!


欲知详情，欲撩开发组，请加官方QQ群地址 76828211 或添加椰岛游戏官方微信 yedaoyouxi
PS.旧版显卡驱动会在开场动画时出现黑屏问题，更新显卡驱动即可解决

notes.title: V1.12更新日志
notes.content:
- 全面改进了职业系统，删除和修改了部分职业，新增职业屠夫，乞丐，盗贼，退伍军人，科学家（脱胎自原职业“植物学家”）以及各具特色的职业属性，并为所有职业增加了独一无二的天赋技能；
- 调整了随机算法，平衡普通难度下的游戏体验；
- 交易系统调整优化，加强了前期交易品的限制，优化了交易内容的合理性；
- 调整了战斗中怒气暴击的伤害，不会再出现怒气暴击伤害过低的情况；
- 优化了撬木箱的手感；
- 略微增加鞋子以及板车升级增加的移动速度；
- 背包增加了关闭按钮（这条不可以不写）；
- 困难以及噩梦难度需在通关普通难度后解锁；
- 减少了普通难度下的心情损耗；
- 调整了力量和体质的作用；
- 改善了字体，修复了部分错误的显示和文字，以及部分操作系统下文字显示不全的bug；
- 游戏正式由椰岛游戏发行与运营，我们会一起努力让游戏变得更好玩，也会更加积极地回应玩家的需求，这次的更新只是一个开始，欲知详情，欲撩开发组，请加官方QQ群地址 76828211 或添加椰岛游戏官方微信 yedaoyouxi 。

 说人话：
- 以前的职业系统太无聊了，努力往好玩改进；
- 不会再因为过于随机而频繁出现极端情况，放下你们手里的矛；
- 交易系统玩得动了；
- 怒气暴击的伤害值不会再低于当前攻击模式下平砍的最大值了；
- 撬木箱从过去的点击长按鼠标松开时判定改为点击判定；
- 尝试缩短游戏的单局长度；
- 不再逼死强迫症；
- ……

还有大家比较关心的几个问题，战斗系统我们已经准备改善，目前还在策划阶段；集换式卡牌系统会有的，尚在设计阶段；游戏的整体体验我们也会从不同的角度尝试改进。
The last but not the least, English version is coming soon.

PS.这次更新后，旧版显卡驱动会在开场动画时出现黑屏问题，更新显卡驱动即可解决ːhappy_creepː
